```{r}
rm(list=ls())
library(readxl)
DATA <- read_excel("Sara_dataset.xls")
```

# 1. Variable descriptions

```{r}
summary(DATA)
```

# 2. Anxiety pre-test vs Anxiety post-test

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
## [- ANXIETY PRE:]{style="color:purple;"}

### Anxiety scores before the test

```{r}
mean_pre <- mean(DATA$anx_pre,na.rm=TRUE)
median_pre <- median(DATA$anx_pre,na.rm=TRUE)
sd_pre <- sd(DATA$anx_pre,na.rm=TRUE)
var_pre <- var(DATA$anx_pre,na.rm=TRUE)
min_pre <- min(DATA$anx_pre,na.rm=TRUE)
max_pre <- max(DATA$anx_pre,na.rm=TRUE)
IQR_pre <- IQR(DATA$anx_pre,na.rm=TRUE)
```

- [Mean]{style="color:purple;"}: `r round(mean_pre, 2)`
- [Median]{style="color:purple;"}: `r round(median_pre, 2)`
- [Standard deviation]{style="color:purple;"}: `r round(sd_pre, 2)`
- [Variance]{style="color:purple;"}: `r round(var_pre, 2)`
- [Min]{style="color:purple;"}: `r round(min_pre, 2)`
- [Max]{style="color:purple;"}: `r round(max_pre, 2)`
- [Interquartile range]{style="color:purple;"}: `r round(IQR_pre, 2)`

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
## 

```{r}
#| label: fig-anx_pre
#| fig-cap: "anxiety pre test scores distribution (n=100)"
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-align: center
boxplot(DATA$anx_pre, col="purple", main="Anxiety pre test")
```
:::
:::::

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}

max_post <- max(DATA$anx_post,na.rm=TRUE)

- [Mean]{style="color:purple;"}: `r round(mean_post, 2)`
- [Median]{style="color:purple;"}: `r round(median_post, 2)`
- [Standard deviation]{style="color:purple;"}: `r round(sd_post, 2)`
